channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Who is Rajinder Gupta? Billionaire from Punjab who gave 40% of AAP’s donations before BJP switch
item.description: Trident's ₹5-crore cheque was dated January 9, 2026, when Gupta was with the Arvind Kejriwal-led party. Gupta thus contributed 40 % of AAP donations last year. However, Gupta joined the BJP, along with six other MPs, in April this year.

item.title: No blanket internet ban, but tighter checks: How India may regulate under-18 social media
item.description: The Supreme Court has asked the Centre to examine statutory safeguards for minors on social media, including whether platforms should prevent those below 18 from independently creating accounts.&nbsp;

item.title: IOC’s Haldia petrochemical expansion gets a land push after years of delay | What CM Adhikari said
item.description: Adhikari said he has taken up the matter with the port authorities to ensure that the land is made available to IOC for its proposed expansion.

item.title: Netanyahu meets MBZ as US-Iran war rages: What’s behind Israel PM's secret UAE visit?
item.description: Netanyahu's trip comes a month before Israel’s October 27 election and against the backdrop of heightened political controversy in Israel over reporting by Haaretz and The NYT alleging that Sheikh Mohammed had warned Netanyahu of a major Hamas operation days before the October 7, 2023, attack.

item.title: UK police release five men arrested over US airbase incident on bail, Trump slams move, says 'I wouldn't have done that'
item.description: After British Police on Monday released five men on bail in connection with the US airbase incident, US President Donald Trump slammed the decision, stating that he would not have done it.

item.title: US-Iran war: Trump rejects report that US will offer Tehran ‘sanctions relief’; Araghchi meets mediators | Top Updates
item.description: US President Donald Trump rejected reports that he was willing to offer Iran sanctions relief and release frozen funds in exchange for progress on its nuclear programme. Meanwhile, Iran said indirect talks with the US continued through Qatari mediators

item.title: Seoul Says North Korea’s Mines Likely Behind DMZ Explosions
item.description: South Korea’s military said North Korean mines were highly likely to have caused blasts that injured three of its soldiers in the Demilitarized Zone last week, and vowed to respond if a final investigation confirms Pyongyang’s involvement.

item.title: Iran war LIVE: Iran says it expects US to answer today on plan to open Hormuz
item.description: Iran war LIVE: US President Donald Trump on Monday (local time) denied a report by the news outlet Axios that he offered Iran sanctions relief and the release of frozen funds, as the Middle East war drags on.

item.title: Goldy Brar on FBI 10 most wanted list; carries a $1 million bounty
item.description: FBI noted that Goldy Brar maintains active networks and operational ties across Sacramento and Fresno in California, as well as Canada, India, and Mexico.

item.title: Video | SpaceX's Starship reaches orbit in historic first but flight ends early: 6 things to know
item.description: SpaceX's Starship reached orbit for the first time and deployed 26 advanced Starlink satellites, but an engine malfunction prompted an early return to Earth. Here's what to know about the milestone flight, the mission's outcome and its implications for NASA's Artemis programme.

item.title: Petrol, diesel prices today, September 29: Check fuel cost in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: Oil prices climbed for a second consecutive session on Tuesday, driven by persistent concerns that the ongoing US-Iran conflict could disrupt supplies in the Middle East

item.title: From films to software—new players hop on to India's e-bus ride
item.description: India’s electric bus push is drawing an unlikely mix of bidders from films and software to solar, as wider eligibility rules open up a subsidised market once dominated by traditional busmakers and fleet operators.

item.title: Jonathan McKinsey, New York Times executive, fatally shot in California as in-laws arrested for killing
item.description: Jonathan McKinsey, a 40-year-old New York Times Games engineering director, was fatally shot in Dublin, California. Police arrested his 77-year-old in-laws within minutes, while investigators have not disclosed a possible motive.

item.title: Milania Giudice seen in tense airport confrontation with mom Teresa as new bodycam footage emerges
item.description: Newly released bodycam footage shows Milania Giudice’s tense airport confrontation with her family, while Teresa claims her daughter had fentanyl in her system. Teresa has since asked for privacy as Milania receives professional care.

item.title: Jacquees arrested in Hollywood on DUI and battery charges: What police allege happened
item.description: R&amp;B singer Jacquees was arrested in Hollywood, Florida, after police said he was found asleep in a vehicle. He faces DUI, battery and resisting charges following an incident involving officers and firefighters.

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe's Maharashtra FDA suspends licence of 122-year-old Kyani cafe in Mumbai: Here's what inspection found
item.description: Tukaram Mundhe-led Maharashtra FDA suspended 30 food licences and seized 50,601.78 kg of food worth ₹1.19 crore. Action included 122-year-old Kyani &amp; Co in Mumbai after hygiene violations were allegedly found during inspection.

item.title: US midterms 2026: Elon Musk, Greg Brockman, Yass among billionaires funding political campaigns, mostly Republican
item.description: As US midterm elections near, billionaires are donating primarily to Republicans. Elon Musk leads donations at $90.5 million, while other notable donors include venture capitalists and executives, collectively contributing substantial amounts to various campaigns.

item.title: What happens after a 14-year-old scores a perfect 1600 on the SAT? Ashrit Talluri is already taking college courses
item.description: Ashrit Talluri, 14, scored a perfect 1600 on the SAT after completing 14½ high-school credits in middle school. Now taking college-level courses, he is also exploring AI, medicine, chess and aviation.

item.title: UAE intends to invest $25 billion more in India, says Goyal
item.description: India and the UAE have decided to set a $200 billion bilateral trade target for 2032 as they deepen cooperation in ports, shipping and energy.

item.title: India Energy Week 2027 to focus on energy security amid global oil-market volatility
item.description: India Energy Week 2027 will focus on energy security, affordability and sustainability amid tighter global oil supplies, with India highlighting its resilience and diversified energy sources.

item.title: FSSAI’s energy drink crackdown: Red Bull sues regulator, says label ban could bring business to standstill
item.description: India in June ordered makers of high-caffeine beverages sold as 'energy drinks' to stop using that description, ​rejecting efforts to stall the regulatory intervention in a market expected to be worth $1.6 billion by 2028.

item.title: Trump administration slashes fuel economy standards for cars, light trucks: Here's what changes
item.description: On Monday, the Trump administration released new fuel economy standards that ease requirements for gasoline vehicles, projecting an average of 34.9 miles per gallon by 2031. This move aligns with Trump's agenda to eliminate mandates favouring electric vehicle production.

item.title: Who is Nitin Gupta? IIT topper returns to India inspired by SRK's film. Why did he choose mosquito brains study?
item.description: Nitin Gupta secured an IIT degree in computer science in 2000. After securing the top rank, he moved to the University of California, San Diego.

item.title: Ashutosh Ranka donated ₹21,100 to AAP before CJP stint – Who else contributed to Kejriwal’s party in 2025-26?
item.description: The Aam Aadmi Party received ₹12.10 crore in donations in 2025-26, a 68 per cent decline from the previous year, according to official filings submitted to the Election Commission of India.

item.title: Delhi steps up winter air pollution action with time-bound measures across key sectors
item.description: The Union and Delhi governments have finalized a time-bound winter action plan targeting vehicular emissions, dust, and industrial pollution through strict enforcement and 37 hotspot interventions.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump ‘no’ to Iran’s peace offer sends oil soaring
item.description: Energy, stock markets take fright as Trump's rejection of Hormuz peace plan raises prospect of a protracted war.

item.title: No AC, dropped elsewhere at midnight: Passenger wins compensation against travel company in consumer court
item.description: A passenger in Visakhapatnam was awarded ₹31,500 after a travel company failed to provide an AC bus and dropped him late at night, 9-10 km from his destination. The commission ruled against the company for both the service failure and safety concerns.

item.title: How Matt Damon’s 2006 Zambia trip inspired a water nonprofit now reaching 92 million people
item.description: Matt Damon launched his water mission in 2006, founding H2O Africa Foundation to support safe-water initiatives. This evolved into Water.org, reaching over 92 million people through a financing model, transforming the global approach to the water crisis from charity to sustainable solutions.

item.title: CBDT extends ITR deadline for taxpayers with audited accounts to 21 November
item.description: The deadline has been extended to 21 November from 31 October, while the deadline for submitting the audit report has been extended to 21 October from 30 September, the ministry of finance said in a statement on Monday.

item.title: US Midterm Elections 2026: Republicans vs Democrats, who will control US House, Senate? Prediction markets reveal odds
item.description: Ahead of the 2028 presidential elections, the November “midterm” election will test the waters for Trump's party, whose second term has largely been controversial. Here's what prediction markets — Kalshi and Polymarket – suggest on the probable outcome of the polls.

item.title: Over one crore FASTag annual passes issued since August 2025 launch: govt
item.description: The ₹3,075 pass offers non-commercial vehicles 200 toll crossings or a year of travel across 1,150 plazas, eliminating the need for frequent recharges.

item.title: Who is David Zervos? Wall St economist and Jeffries' marketing head tapped to advise US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent
item.description: David Zervos, a veteran Wall Street economist, has been appointed as a counselor by US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. He will start immediately, bringing extensive experience to the Treasury after several staff departures. Zervos was the chief market strategist for Jeffries since 2010.

item.title: Who is Parvesh Verma? Delhi Police file Non-cognisable report against BJP minister involved in Tilak Nagar slap row
item.description: Delhi PWD Minister Parvesh Sahib Singh Verma faces backlash after a video shows him allegedly slapping a man during a road inspection. Delhi Police filed a non-cognisable report against Verma under charges of voluntarily causing hurt in connection with the incident.

item.title: UK to open ‘legal routes’ for refugees, prioritising Afghan women, Palestinians: ‘Fairness is what unites us’
item.description: The scheme is likely to attract strong criticism from the right, as women, girls and people with disabilities are more likely to rely on state-provided welfare support.

item.title: Was Iran involved in suspected bomb plot at RAF base being used by US? What police said
item.description: British counter-terrorism police are investigating a potential Iranian link to a bomb scare at a US air base. Five men were detained on suspicion of planning a ‘terrorist act’ after suspicious vans were reported near RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire.
